prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1343; do not mention it.)
text: My client was injured in a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other driver was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Kindly provide, in writing, the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that your insured be instructed to preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including vehicle data, dash camera footage, photographs, repair records, telephone records for the time of the collision, and any statements previously obtained. Please confirm in writing within fourteen days that this preservation request has been received and that the relevant materials are being retained. We look forward to your prompt response so that this claim can be evaluated efficiently.
